data.creator_notes:
My first furry Anthro boy, Big Ralph.
As of writing this, I haven't yet tested him. I don't know how well he works, how aggressive he may or may not be, or how well he follows his description as the API I normally use is currently down for the time being. So if you do use the boy, I would appreciate it if you gave some feedback on how well he does or doesn't work.

But all the same, I've been really trying to get back into making characters. I want to do it more often on a set schedule. At some point, I will hammer that out.

As for Ralph and his creation, I have been testing the new model I'm using for Stable Diffusion, hoping to stick to one model that can generate similar styles and decently consistent designs. While testing its Anthro/Furry adherence, the image I got for that just had to be made into a character bot, so I wrote some stuff up on the fly. 

As per usual, Ralph should be easy to use from any POV, though currently, there is only one starting message, and it's pretty heavily implied in that starting message that you are trying to steal from or undermine Ralph and his mafia group in some way or another. Still, I suppose you could be Ralph's right hand or even one of the goons holding that person down. I will likely be adding some alternative greetings at some point. Oh, and another thing the idea was meant to be that he is insanely dominant, unlike my usual bots. Just a fair warning.
